Metadata.defaultTitle: Epora Wallet — Shared Cardano smart wallet
Metadata.description: Share a non-custodial Cardano smart wallet. Set owners, daily spending limits, required approvals, scheduled payments, and time-delayed recovery shares. Built on Preprod.
Metadata.faqCustodyAnswer: No. Epora is non-custodial. Your ADA stays in a Cardano smart contract governed by rules you set, and every action is authorized by your own connected wallet. Epora never takes custody of your keys or funds.
Metadata.faqCustodyQuestion: Does Epora Wallet hold my keys or funds?
Metadata.faqDifferenceAnswer: Epora puts shared-control rules on-chain. One smart wallet can have owners, spenders with daily limits, required approval groups, scheduled payments, and time-delayed share withdrawals for recovery contacts.
Metadata.faqDifferenceQuestion: How is Epora Wallet different from a regular Cardano wallet?
Metadata.faqNetworkAnswer: No. Epora currently runs on Cardano Preprod. This beta is unaudited and can fail, so use test assets only.
Metadata.faqNetworkQuestion: Is Epora Wallet on Cardano mainnet?
Metadata.faqTimerAnswer: A dead-man switch opens a recovery path when owners stop extending a timer. In Epora, each recovery contact may withdraw their configured share once the wake-up timer and any personal delay have expired.
Metadata.faqTimerQuestion: What is a dead-man switch wallet?
Metadata.faqWhatAnswer: Epora is a non-custodial Cardano smart wallet for more than one person. Owners set the rules, spenders use daily limits, and recovery contacts can withdraw a configured share once the wake-up timer expires. You approve actions with your own Cardano browser wallet.
Metadata.featureGovernance: Experimental Cardano staking and governance surfaces
Metadata.featurePayments: Scheduled payment accrual with signer-started payouts
Metadata.featureRecovery: Wake-up timer for one-time recovery-share withdrawals
Metadata.featureSharedControl: Shared control with owners, spenders, and recovery contacts

Metadata.socialDescription: Share control of a Cardano smart wallet, set spending limits, and plan time-delayed recovery withdrawals. Open source, Catalyst-funded, and live on Preprod.
Metadata.socialTitle: Epora Wallet — One wallet, shared on your terms
Metadata.structuredDescription: Epora is a non-custodial Cardano smart wallet for shared control. Owners set the rules, spenders use daily limits, and recovery contacts can make a one-time share withdrawal after a timer expires.
